item.title: County courthouse and Boerne City Hall close November 26 and 27; trash collection slides one day
item.description: The Kendall County Courthouse and Boerne City Hall, including Boerne Utilities, will be closed Thursday, November 26, and Friday, November 27, for Thanksgiving, and WM trash and recycling collection in Boerne will be delayed by one day that week.

item.title: Freeze Warning for Kendall County until 9:00 AM on November 25
item.description: The National Weather Service has issued a Freeze Warning for Kendall County, in effect from midnight tonight to 9:00 AM CST Wednesday, with sub-freezing temperatures between 26 and 32 expected.

item.title: Commissioners Court honors the late Judge Frieda Pressler
item.description: Kendall County Commissioners Court recognized the late Judge Frieda Pressler on Tuesday, presenting a memorial plaque to her family. Pressler began with Kendall County EMS in the early 1980s and served as Precinct 4 justice of the peace from 1986 until her death on September 6, 2026.

item.title: Court sets December 8 interviews for Precinct 4 constable, raises retirement contribution
item.description: Kendall County Commissioners Court voted Tuesday to interview applicants for the appointed Precinct 4 constable position on December 8, with letters of interest due December 4. In other action, the court raised the county retirement contribution from 195 percent to 200 percent on a 3 to 1 vote, extended both library agreements, and approved an EMS medical director contract.

item.title: Boerne girls beat Churchill 51-20
item.description: The Boerne High School girls basketball team beat Churchill 51-20 on Monday, November 23, at Churchill, with Boerne also winning the junior varsity game 45-29 and the freshman game 34-30.

item.title: Kronkosky State Natural Area opens December 1
item.description: Texas Parks and Wildlife announced November 18 that the Albert and Bessie Kronkosky State Natural Area outside Boerne opens for day use on December 1, with overnight stays starting December 15.

item.title: Freeze Warning for Kendall County until 9:00 AM on November 25
item.description: The National Weather Service has issued a Freeze Warning for Kendall County, in effect from midnight Tuesday night to 9:00 AM CST Wednesday, with sub-freezing temperatures between 26 and 32 expected.

item.title: Boerne's Matthew Williams earned the Medal of Honor in the Shok Valley
item.description: Matthew O. Williams was born in Boerne in 1981 and spent most of his childhood here. As a Special Forces weapons sergeant in Afghanistan's Shok Valley on April 6, 2008, he led a counterattack under fire, carried wounded teammates down a mountain, and helped save four soldiers. His Silver Star was upgraded to the Medal of Honor, presented at the White House on October 30, 2019.

item.title: Kimberly Simmons named Boerne ISD director of alternative programs
item.description: Boerne ISD announced on November 19 that Kimberly Simmons, an assistant principal, has been promoted to director of alternative programs, overseeing Boerne Academy, the 18+ program at the Mitchell Learning Center, and the district alternative education program. She begins the role on January 5, 2027.

item.title: Regional semifinal matchups set for Boerne and Champion
item.description: Boerne Champion will face Austin Anderson and Boerne High will face Liberty Hill Legacy Ranch in the regional semifinals on Friday, November 27, after Anderson and Legacy Ranch won their area round games on Friday night, November 20. Champion plays at 2:00 p.m. at Buda's Shelton Stadium; Boerne plays at 1:00 p.m. at Cedar Park's Gupton Stadium.

item.title: Boerne ISD teachers receive more than $200,000 in innovation grants
item.description: Boerne ISD teachers received more than $200,000 in Teacher Innovation Grants when the Boerne Education Foundation Prize Parade visited classrooms across the district, the district announced November 19. The grants reached teachers at every campus.

item.title: Both Boerne teams roll in Laredo: Champion 72-14, Greyhounds 41-7
item.description: Boerne Champion beat McAllen High 72-14 and Boerne High beat Mercedes 41-7 on Thursday night, November 19, in Laredo in the area round of the UIL playoffs. Champion improved to 11-1 and Boerne to 12-0, and both teams advance to the regional semifinals on Thanksgiving weekend.

item.title: Boerne authors take first place at state genealogical awards for Bickel massacre book
item.description: Richard G. Tomlinson and Kathryn L. Adam-Hurst won first place in the Texas State Genealogical Society's 2026 Book Awards for 'Murder in Boerne, Texas: The Untold Story of the Bickel Family Massacre,' their three-year reconstruction of an 1868 Kendall County murder case.

item.title: Operation Christmas Child collection week runs through November 23 in Boerne
item.description: Operation Christmas Child National Collection Week runs November 16 to 23, 2026. St. John Lutheran Church at 315 Rosewood Avenue in Boerne is the Kendall County area collection site for gift-filled shoeboxes, per the Boerne Star and the church.

item.title: Allen Graham convicted in fatal Interstate 10 crash, receives maximum sentence
item.description: A Kendall County jury convicted Allen Remard Graham Jr., 28, of San Antonio, of intoxication manslaughter, manslaughter, and intoxication assault in the February 16, 2025 head-on crash on Interstate 10 near Comfort that killed Manuela Rodriguez. He was sentenced to 20 years and 10 years in state prison, the maximum sentences allowed by law.

item.title: Canvass adds 35 ballots as court makes November 3 results official
item.description: Commissioners Court canvassed the November 3 returns on November 18 and approved them 4-0. The official count is 26,311 ballots, 35 more than the unofficial total.

item.title: Boerne ISD trustees review middle school boundary recommendation
item.description: Boerne ISD trustees reviewed a Campus Boundary Committee recommendation on November 16 to move the Esperanza neighborhood from Boerne Middle School North to Voss Middle School and place the full Fabra Elementary zone in the North zone for 2027-28, with a decision scheduled December 14.

item.title: City of Boerne hosts Adler Road meeting November 18
item.description: The City of Boerne hosts a come-and-go public meeting on Phase 2 of the Adler Road reconstruction on Wednesday, November 18, from 5 to 7 p.m. at Curington Elementary School, 601 Adler Road.

item.title: Commissioners Court agenda lists Comfort setback request, two guarantee releases
item.description: The November 10 Commissioners Court agenda listed a request to reduce setbacks for a proposed development at 714 High Street in Comfort and two releases of financial guarantees for subdivision improvements, totaling $1,027,670.05 and $4,152,025.70.

item.title: Both Boerne ISD teams play Thursday in Laredo
item.description: Boerne High and Boerne Champion play area round playoff games at the same time Thursday, November 19, in Laredo. Boerne faces Mercedes at Shirley Field at 7 p.m., and Champion faces McAllen at the Student Activity Center at 7 p.m.
